response_header_policy.server: disabled on Uvicorn; absent in Rust

metadata.timing_median_policy: at least three unique timing_valid repetitions; every excluded/partial raw row is retained
metadata.process_isolation: owned POSIX sessions; track root/descendant PID and create_time; leader SIGINT triggers official graceful shutdown, then identity-verified TERM/KILL per owned PID if needed; no process-group signal probes
metadata.client_wall_limit: requested duration plus 30 seconds for warmup and measured load independently

host_contention_policy.excluded: runner ancestors and runner/server/client descendant PIDs

metadata.load_model: closed loop: each worker sends its next request after the previous complete response
metadata.latency_limitations: no open-loop offered-rate test or coordinated-omission correction; latency includes client work
metadata.resource_boundary: client process lifetime, including setup/drain/report; client active request windows vary by protocol
metadata.memory_limitations: sampled process-tree RSS peak; not allocator peak or proportional/private set size
metadata.client: threaded libcurl C workers with persistent HTTP/1.1 connections and complete response-body checks
metadata.correctness_gate: every measured response status and complete body exactly matches the workload oracle
metadata.native_client: libcurl C client compiled from scripts/bench_http_client.c
metadata.fallback_client: Node.js HTTP/1.1 with full body checking; used for slow-reader backpressure

rows.observer_limitations: same-host observer consumes CPU; its measured CPU is reported and excluded from unrelated-process contention
rows.client_cpu_limitations: reaped-child rusage delta includes setup/drain/report; no other runner children are reaped in this boundary

server_shutdown.cleanup_verification: original root reaped; tracked original descendant identities exited or are zombies; recycled PIDs ignored
